articles.title: Objectionable Slogans During Muharram Spark Outrage in Gorakhpur, 3 Held
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Gorakhpur — Tension erupted in Piprauli of the GIDA area after a video of objectionable slogans raised during the tenth-day Muharram procession went viral on social media.

body.html:
Gorakhpur — Tension erupted in Piprauli of the GIDA area after a video of objectionable slogans raised during the tenth-day Muharram procession went viral on social media.

Angry villagers staged a protest, following which police registered a case against three named persons — Sheru, Shahil, and Aman — along with 100 unidentified individuals based on a complaint by the outpost in-charge.

According to police, the main accused, Sheru, allegedly raised the slogans using a DJ mike. All three accused were taken into custody, where they were seen apologising for their actions.

articles.title: Hayabusa Horror: High-Speed Luxury Bike Crash Kills Two in Mysuru — Was It a Midnight Race?
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | Two men, including a food delivery worker, died in a high-speed crash on Nelson Mandela Road when a ₹15L Hayabusa rammed into a scooter & caught fire. CCTV being checked for possible bike race before the accident. FIR filed, probe on.

body.html:
#InShort | Two men, including a food delivery worker, died in a high-speed crash on Nelson Mandela Road when a ₹15L Hayabusa rammed into a scooter & caught fire. CCTV being checked for possible bike race before the accident. FIR filed, probe on.

* * *

Mysuru — Two men, including a food delivery worker, were killed in a high-speed crash after a luxury bike collided with a scooter on Nelson Mandela Road in Bannimantap early Sunday, 6 July.

The deceased have been identified as Syed Sharen (30), a resident of K.P. Mohalla in Chamarajanagar, who was riding a ₹15 lakh Hayabusa, and M.S. Karthik (42), a food delivery worker from Shettinayakanahalli in Mysuru taluk.

Police said the accident occurred around 2 am when Sharen’s high-end bike, reportedly at high speed, rammed into Karthik’s scooter as he was heading for a delivery. After the collision, the bike hit an electric pole and caught fire. Both riders suffered fatal head injuries and died on the spot.

DCP K.N. Sunder Raj, NR Traffic Inspector Rekha Bai, and other police officials visited the spot and conducted an inspection. An FIR has been filed at the NR Traffic Police Station.

Sources indicated that a bike race may have preceded the accident. Police are examining CCTV footage from the stretch between Highway Circle and LIC Circle to confirm if racing was involved.

articles.title: Intentional Hit-and-Run? Students Ram Teacher’s Scooty, Flee Scene — No Police Action for 3 Days!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | Sector-23: A car, allegedly driven by students, rammed into teacher Sangeeta Tikaram’s scooty & fled, injuring her. CCTV shows the car with a tampered plate. Police acted only after video went viral. Probe on.

body.html:
#InShort | Sector-23: A car, allegedly driven by students, rammed into teacher Sangeeta Tikaram’s scooty & fled, injuring her. CCTV shows the car with a tampered plate. Police acted only after video went viral. Probe on.

* * *

A shocking incident surfaced in the city where a car, allegedly driven by students, rammed into a female teacher’s scooty from behind and fled the scene. The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. It is suspected that the teacher was intentionally targeted.

According to the complaint filed by her husband Arun Malik, his wife Sangeeta Tikaram, a teacher at a girls’ school, was on her way to work on Thursday morning. While crossing the 100-feet-wide road in Sector-23, a car hit her from behind, injuring her feet and elbows.

Instead of helping her, the students sped away in the car. Arun Malik claimed the car’s number plate had been tampered with — the CCTV footage showed a number belonging to a bike. He filed a complaint on 4 July, but alleges that police took no action for three days.

The investigation reportedly began only after the video of the incident went viral. Police spokesperson Ravindra stated that efforts are underway to identify the car and trace the accused based on the CCTV footage.

articles.title: Horror on Tracks: School Bus Hit by Train in Tamil Nadu, 2 Children Dead, Others Critical
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu — A tragic accident occurred at Semmankuppam near Cuddalore on Monday (07/July/2025) when a school bus was struck by a passenger train while crossing a railway track, killing at least two children and injuring four others, including the driver.

body.html:
Cuddalore, Tamil Nadu — A tragic accident occurred at Semmankuppam near Cuddalore on Monday (07/July/2025) when a school bus was struck by a passenger train while crossing a railway track, killing at least two children and injuring four others, including the driver.

The horrific collision happened at a manned but non-interlocked railway gate between Cuddalore and Alappakkam, when the bus belonging to a private school tried to cross the tracks. The Villupuram–Mayiladuthurai passenger train (No. 56813) rammed into the bus, leaving it badly mangled.

Police confirmed that two students died on the spot, while three others and the driver sustained serious injuries. All the injured were rushed to the Cuddalore Government Hospital for treatment.

Authorities fear the death toll could rise as some of the injured are critical. An investigation has been launched to ascertain if there was any negligence at the gate.

body.html:
Bulandshahr, Uttar Pradesh — In a shocking incident, a group of children in Bulandshahr were seen playing with a 15-foot-long python they found while bathing in a river. The matter came to the notice of the forest department after the video spread widely. Officials later reached the spot, rescued the python from the children, and released it safely into the wild.

articles.title: Meerut Shocker: Wife and Daughter Kill Farmer Over ‘Love Affairs’, Lovers Among 5 Arrested
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Meerut — In a chilling incident in Jani area of Meerut, a farmer was allegedly murdered by his wife and daughter, aided by their lovers, as he opposed their illicit relationships.

body.html:
Meerut — In a chilling incident in Jani area of Meerut, a farmer was allegedly murdered by his wife and daughter, aided by their lovers, as he opposed their illicit relationships. The police have arrested five accused, including the wife, daughter, and two lovers, in connection with the crime.

The deceased, identified as Subhash Upadhyay, around 60, was a hardworking farmer who toiled daily to provide for his family. Unbeknownst to him, his wife Kavita was allegedly in an affair with a Muslim youth, Gulzar, while his daughter Sonam was in a relationship with a Dalit boy, and wanted to marry him.

When Subhash came to know about these affairs and reportedly objected, the wife and daughter, along with their lovers, allegedly plotted his murder.

On Monday night, Subhash had gone to irrigate his fields in the jungles of Sisaula Kalan. According to police, the accused lay in wait and shot him in the waist. Believing him dead, they fled. Subhash somehow dragged himself to the Gang Canal track, where villagers found him and informed the police.

He was rushed to hospital but succumbed to his injuries during treatment. His body was sent for postmortem and later cremated in a sombre atmosphere in Jani Khurd village.

The police initially registered a case against unknown assailants on the complaint of Subhash’s son Ayush. However, investigation soon revealed the alleged conspiracy involving his wife and daughter.

Jani police station in-charge Mahesh Rathore said the motive appears to be personal enmity within the family over the women’s affairs. Further investigation is underway, and the police have assured that all culprits will be brought to justice.

articles.title: Himachal Miracle: 11-Month-Old Baby Survives Flash Floods That Swept Away Her Family
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Mandi — In a heart-wrenching yet miraculous incident during the flash floods in Himachal Pradesh, an 11-month-old baby girl, Nikita, survived even as her parents and grandmother were swept away by raging waters on the night of 30 June in the Seraj Assembly constituency.

body.html:
Mandi — In a heart-wrenching yet miraculous incident during the flash floods in Himachal Pradesh, an 11-month-old baby girl, Nikita, survived even as her parents and grandmother were swept away by raging waters on the night of 30 June in the Seraj Assembly constituency.

According to officials, Nikita’s father Ramesh, mother Radha, and grandmother Purnu Devi attempted to divert the overflowing stream behind their home amid heavy rainfall. While they were swept away, Nikita, who was asleep inside the house, was later found alive and unharmed.

Ramesh’s body has been recovered, while search operations for Radha and Purnu Devi are ongoing.

A viral video of Nikita, playing in the arms of Gohar SDM Smritika Negi, has caught the nation’s attention, showing the child blissfully unaware of the tragedy. Nikita is currently in the care of her paternal aunt Tara Devi.

Smritika Negi confirmed that many have come forward expressing willingness to adopt Nikita and said she personally spends time with the child whenever she visits.

Meanwhile, Smritika Negi was also seen helping two pregnant women stranded in the flash floods, personally transporting them to the hospital in her own vehicle. A video shared on X showed her overseeing their rescue and ensuring timely medical care with help from local villagers.

The flash floods that struck the region on 30 June and 1 July have claimed several lives and rendered many homeless, leaving the area devastated.

articles.title: Haridwar Horror: Kanwariyas Attack Muslim Family After Minor Accident, Car Vandalised
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Haridwar — A disturbing case of communal violence has come to light from Haridwar’s Manglaur area, where a group of Kanwariyas allegedly assaulted a Muslim family and vandalised their car after a minor road accident.

body.html:
Haridwar — A disturbing case of communal violence has come to light from Haridwar’s Manglaur area, where a group of Kanwariyas allegedly assaulted a Muslim family and vandalised their car after a minor road accident.

The incident occurred when a car carrying the family — including women and children — accidentally brushed against some Kanwariyas walking on the road during their pilgrimage. According to eyewitnesses and video footage, the situation escalated after the attackers realised the driver belonged to the Muslim community.

The videos, which have since gone viral on social media, show the Kanwariyas forcing the family out of their car, breaking the doors, chasing the male passengers, and assaulting them while causing extensive damage to the vehicle.

Following public outrage, Haridwar Police registered an FIR at Manglaur Police Station under relevant sections for assault and damage to property.

In an official statement, police said: “During the Kanwar Yatra in Manglaur, when a car brushed against Kanwariyas, they attempted to damage the vehicle in anger. A case has been registered, and legal action is being taken.”

The incident has sparked strong condemnation online, with many demanding strict action against the accused. Police have assured that the matter is being investigated thoroughly.
